subject.title: Agent陷入工具调用失败死循环，导致重复发送消息刷屏

question: Should OpenClaw add a default-on guard for deterministic tool validation failures and duplicate visible retry messages, and what threshold/user-facing failure wording should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but changing default hard-stop behavior and channel-visible messaging can affect legitimate retry and polling workflows, so automation should not choose the product policy alone.

options.title: Narrow default validation guard
options.body: Classify deterministic validation errors as bounded or terminal by default and emit one structured channel-visible failure summary while leaving broader rolling detection opt-in.

options.title: Enable broader rolling detection by default
options.body: Turn on the existing rolling detector for all users with conservative thresholds, accepting a wider compatibility and false-positive surface.

options.title: Keep opt-in only
options.body: Leave current defaults unchanged and document tools.loopDetection.enabled for users who prefer stronger runtime guardrails.

recommendation.title: Narrow default validation guard
recommendation.body: Classify deterministic validation errors as bounded or terminal by default and emit one structured channel-visible failure summary while leaving broader rolling detection opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: The current default-off detector and configurable loop-detection surface are most directly tied to this history trail.
